description: WATCHES a page for changes: Writ checks it on a schedule and fires change_detected when the page, a CSS selector's text, a value read by `extract`, or a visual zone changes. Returns the monitor_id that writ_wire_monitor connects to an alert, a workflow or an AI task (a price watch takes a threshold there). Without `interval` the answer is needs_input: this plan's options and a tell_user for the user, nothing created. The page is read first: a sign-in answers needs_persona, a bot check offers use_residential.

extract.description: Browserless read instead of a selector, e.g. {"from":"html_css","selector":".price"}.

interval.description: How often: an option id from needs_input ('5m', '1h', '24h') or seconds.

selector.description: CSS selector whose text is watched (unset = whole page / uptime).

use_residential.description: Check through a residential exit (bot walls).

watch.description: content (default) | price (the value must hold a number).

name: writ_create_monitor
title: Watch a page for changes
